artifacts.summary: Eight-phase, five-wave plan to scaffold the books extension in the source store: manifest with two routing blocks (books, books:certify), four sonnet agents with --hard variants, six skills, /book and /certify commands, a flattened-layout books rule, one declared passthrough script plus its fixture test, and the four registration/doc files, gated by check-extension-docs.sh and a re-measured task-type detection table.

memory_candidates.content: When authoring a new agent-system extension, check-extension-docs.sh Rule E (check_referenced_scripts_declared) extracts every '[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.(sh|sql)\b' token from the extension's commands/*.md, skills/*/SKILL.md, agents/*.md, README.md and EXTENSION.md, and hard-fails on any token not declared in some extension's provides.scripts/provides.hooks (basename-normalized; no allowlist, no severity knob). rules/*.md is NOT scanned. Consequence: a command that documents its real invocation of a CONSUMING REPOSITORY's shell script cannot name that script by filename in those five locations -- the fix is to ship a thin, declared extension-local passthrough wrapper and name the wrapper instead, or to confine the bare filename to a rule file. Related on-disk constraints from the same lint: provides.context/scripts/rules entries must exist on disk (so an extension declaring a context dir whose corpus is a separate task still needs a stub there), EXTENSION.md is capped at 60 lines, README.md must mention every manifest command and must be newer than manifest.json, and index-entries.json line_count must equal wc -l of the source file with no description/tags/tier keys.
